```python
# ============================================================
# COMPLETE RAG EVALUATION MASTER SUMMARY VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(28, 20))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#0D1117')

ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 28)
ax.set_ylim(0, 20)
ax.axis('off')
ax.set_facecolor('#0D1117')

# ── TITLE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.text(14, 19.3, '🎯 RAG EVALUATION — COMPLETE REFERENCE MAP',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color='white')
ax.text(14, 18.7, 'Retriever Evaluation  •  Generation Evaluation  •  End-to-End Evaluation',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, color='#8B949E')

# ── SECTION 1: RETRIEVER EVALUATION ─────────────────────────
ret_bg = FancyBboxPatch((0.3, 9.5), 8.5, 8.8,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", linewidth=2.5,
                         edgecolor='#7B1FA2', facecolor='#12001A', alpha=0.95)
ax.add_patch(ret_bg)
ax.text(4.55, 18.0, '🔍  RETRIEVER EVALUATION', ha='center',
        fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color='#CE93D8')

ret_metrics = [
    ('Precision@K',  '✅ Relevant / Retrieved',         'P = rel_k / K',                 0.75, '#7B1FA2'),
    ('Recall@K',     '✅ Relevant / All Relevant',      'R = rel_k / total_rel',          0.80, '#9C27B0'),
    ('F1 Score',     '⚖️  Harmonic Mean P & R',          'F1 = 2PR/(P+R)',                 0.77, '#AB47BC'),
    ('MRR',          '🥇 Rank of 1st Relevant Doc',     'MRR = avg(1/rank)',              0.68, '#BA68C8'),
    ('NDCG@K',       '📊 Graded Relevance + Position',  'NDCG = DCG / IDCG',             0.82, '#CE93D8'),
    ('Hit Rate@K',   '🎯 At Least 1 Relevant in Top-K', 'Hit = 1 if any relevant in K', 0.90, '#E1BEE7'),
]

for i, (name, desc, formula, score, color) in enumerate(ret_metrics):
    y = 17.0 - i * 1.2
    bg = FancyBboxPatch((0.5, y-0.4), 8.1, 0.95,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.05", linewidth=1,
                         edgecolor=color, facecolor=color + '22')
    ax.add_patch(bg)
    ax.text(0.85, y+0.15, name, fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=color, va='center')
    ax.text(0.85, y-0.15, desc, fontsize=7.5, color='#CCCCCC', va='center')
    ax.text(5.5, y+0.15, formula, fontsize=8, color='#FFE082', va='center', style='italic')
    score_bar_w = score * 2.5
    ax.barh(y, score_bar_w, 0.25, left=5.5, color=color, alpha=0.6)
    ax.text(5.5 + score_bar_w + 0.05, y, f'{score:.2f}',
            va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#4CAF50')

# ── SECTION 2: GENERATION EVALUATION ────────────────────────
gen_bg = FancyBboxPatch((9.5, 9.5), 8.5, 8.8,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", linewidth=2.5,
                          edgecolor='#E65100', facecolor='#1A0500', alpha=0.95)
ax.add_patch(gen_bg)
ax.text(13.75, 18.0, '🧠  GENERATION EVALUATION', ha='center',
        fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color='#FFCCBC')

gen_metrics = [
    ('Faithfulness',        '🛡️  Claims Grounded in Context',     'F = supported / total_claims',       0.88, '#E65100'),
    ('Answer Relevancy',    '🎯 Answer Addresses Question',       'AR = cosine_sim(gen_Qs, original_Q)', 0.85, '#F4511E'),
    ('Hallucination Rate',  '👻 Fabricated Information Rate',     'H = 1 - Faithfulness',                0.12, '#FF5722'),
    ('Fluency',             '💬 Grammar & Natural Flow',          'LLM Judge Score (1-5)',               4.2, '#FF7043'),
    ('Coherence',           '🧵 Logical Idea Flow',               'LLM Judge Score (1-5)',               4.0, '#FF8A65'),
    ('Toxicity & Safety',   '⚠️  Harmful Content Detection',      'Toxic classifier score',              0.02, '#FFAB91'),
]

for i, (name, desc, formula, score, color) in enumerate(gen_metrics):
    y = 17.0 - i * 1.2
    bg = FancyBboxPatch((9.7, y-0.4), 8.1, 0.95,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.05", linewidth=1,
                         edgecolor=color, facecolor=color + '22')
    ax.add_patch(bg)
    ax.text(10.05, y+0.15, name, fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=color, va='center')
    ax.text(10.05, y-0.15, desc, fontsize=7.5, color='#CCCCCC', va='center')
    norm_score = score / 5 if score > 1 else (1 - score if name == 'Hallucination Rate' else score)
    score_bar_w = norm_score * 2.5
    ax.barh(y, score_bar_w, 0.25, left=15.0, color=color, alpha=0.6)
    ax.text(15.0 + score_bar_w + 0.05, y, f'{score:.2f}',
            va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#4CAF50')

# ── SECTION 3: END-TO-END EVALUATION ────────────────────────
e2e_bg = FancyBboxPatch((18.7, 9.5), 8.8, 8.8,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", linewidth=2.5,
                          edgecolor='#1565C0', facecolor='#00050F', alpha=0.95)
ax.add_patch(e2e_bg)
ax.text(23.1, 18.0, '🔄  END-TO-END EVALUATION', ha='center',
        fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color='#90CAF9')

e2e_metrics = [
    ('Context Precision',  '📦 Relevant Retrieved Chunks',      'CP = useful_chunks / K',            0.80, '#1565C0'),
    ('Context Recall',     '📚 Needed Info in Context',         'CR = covered_facts / all_facts',    0.85, '#1976D2'),
    ('RAGAS Score',        '🔬 Harmonic Mean All 4 Metrics',    '4/(1/CP+1/CR+1/F+1/AR)',            0.84, '#1E88E5'),
    ('LLM-as-Judge',       '⚖️  LLM Evaluates Answer Quality',  'GPT-4 Rubric (1-5)',                4.25, '#2196F3'),
    ('Human Evaluation',   '👤 Gold Standard Human Ratings',    'Cohen κ > 0.6 for IAA',             4.50, '#42A5F5'),
    ('Coverage Rate',      '📡 % Queries Answerable',           'Coverage = answered / total_Q',     0.92, '#64B5F6'),
]

for i, (name, desc, formula, score, color) in enumerate(e2e_metrics):
    y = 17.0 - i * 1.2
    bg = FancyBboxPatch((19.0, y-0.4), 8.2, 0.95,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.05", linewidth=1,
                         edgecolor=color, facecolor=color + '22')
    ax.add_patch(bg)
    ax.text(19.3, y+0.15, name, fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=color, va='center')
    ax.text(19.3, y-0.15, desc, fontsize=7.5, color='#CCCCCC', va='center')
    norm_score = score / 5 if score > 1 else score
    score_bar_w = norm_score * 2.5
    ax.barh(y, score_bar_w, 0.25, left=24.0, color=color, alpha=0.6)
    ax.text(24.0 + score_bar_w + 0.05, y, f'{score:.2f}',
            va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#4CAF50')

# ── RAG PIPELINE FLOW (middle row) ──────────────────────────
flow_y = 8.5
pipeline_items = [
    (2.0,  '📝 User Query',       '#455A64'),
    (6.5,  '🔍 Retriever',        '#7B1FA2'),
    (11.5, '📄 Context Chunks',   '#1B5E20'),
    (16.5, '🤖 LLM Generator',    '#E65100'),
    (21.5, '💬 Final Answer',     '#B71C1C'),
    (26.0, '👤 User',             '#37474F'),
]

for x, label, color in pipeline_items:
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x-1.3, flow_y-0.45), 2.6, 0.9,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", linewidth=2,
                          edgecolor=color, facecolor=color + '55')
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(x, flow_y, label, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white')

# Pipeline arrows
for x_start, x_end in [(3.3, 5.2), (7.8, 10.2), (12.8, 15.2),
                         (17.8, 20.2), (22.8, 24.7)]:
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x_end, flow_y), xytext=(x_start, flow_y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#4CAF50',
                                lw=2.5, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0'))

# Evaluation bracket labels
ax.annotate('', xy=(8.8, 9.3), xytext=(0.3, 9.3),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#CE93D8', lw=2))
ax.text(4.55, 9.0, 'RETRIEVER EVAL', ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#CE93D8', fontweight='bold')

ax.annotate('', xy=(18.2, 9.3), xytext=(9.5, 9.3),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#FFCCBC', lw=2))
ax.text(13.85, 9.0, 'GENERATION EVAL', ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#FFCCBC', fontweight='bold')

ax.annotate('', xy=(27.5, 9.3), xytext=(0.3, 9.3),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#90CAF9', lw=1.5, linestyle='dashed'))
ax.text(14, 8.7, 'END-TO-END EVALUATION', ha='center', fontsize=9,
        color='#90CAF9', fontweight='bold',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#0D1117', alpha=0.8))

# ── BOTTOM: METRICS QUICK REFERENCE TABLE ───────────────────
table_bg = FancyBboxPatch((0.3, 0.3), 27.2, 7.8,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", linewidth=2,
                            edgecolor='#37474F', facecolor='#0A0F14', alpha=0.97)
ax.add_patch(table_bg)
ax.text(14, 7.9, '📋  QUICK REFERENCE: WHEN TO USE WHICH METRIC',
        ha='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color='white')

col_headers = ['Metric', 'Formula', 'Range', 'Best For', 'Limitation', 'Threshold (Good)', 'Category']
col_x = [0.7, 4.0, 7.5, 9.0, 13.5, 18.5, 23.0]
header_y = 7.3

for header, x in zip(col_headers, col_x):
    ax.text(x, header_y, header, fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#64B5F6', va='center')

ax.axhline(y=7.0, xmin=0.012, xmax=0.988, color='#37474F', linewidth=1)

table_rows = [
    ('Precision@K', 'rel_k / K',         '0–1', 'Query-time noisy ctx check',    'Ignores recall',         '≥ 0.70',   'Retrieval', '#CE93D8'),
    ('Recall@K',    'rel_k / all_rel',    '0–1', 'Safety-critical completeness',   'Needs labeled corpus',   '≥ 0.75',   'Retrieval', '#BA68C8'),
    ('F1 Score',    '2PR/(P+R)',          '0–1', 'Balanced P & R single score',    'Binary relevance only',  '≥ 0.70',   'Retrieval', '#AB47BC'),
    ('MRR',         'avg(1/rank_first)',  '0–1', 'Single-answer voice/search',     'Ignores rank 2+',        '≥ 0.70',   'Retrieval', '#9C27B0'),
    ('NDCG@K',      'DCG / IDCG',        '0–1', 'Graded relevance ranking',       'Needs graded labels',    '≥ 0.75',   'Retrieval', '#7B1FA2'),
    ('Faithfulness','supported/claims',  '0–1', 'Hallucination detection',        'Expensive (LLM judge)',  '≥ 0.85',   'Generation','#FF5722'),
    ('Ans. Relev.', 'cosine(gen_Q, Q)',  '0–1', 'Answer addresses question',      'LLM judge needed',       '≥ 0.80',   'Generation','#FF7043'),
    ('Ctx Precision','useful/retrieved', '0–1', 'Context noise detection',        'Needs GT answers',       '≥ 0.75',   'End-to-End','#2196F3'),
    ('Ctx Recall',  'covered/GT_facts',  '0–1', 'Context completeness check',     'Needs GT answers',       '≥ 0.80',   'End-to-End','#1976D2'),
    ('RAGAS Score', 'harmonic(CP,CR,F,AR)','0–1','Overall RAG quality score',      'LLM judge cost',         '≥ 0.80',   'End-to-End','#1565C0'),
    ('LLM Judge',   'GPT-4 rubric (1-5)','1–5', 'Nuanced quality assessment',     'Expensive, biased',      '≥ 4.0/5',  'End-to-End','#42A5F5'),
    ('Human Eval',  'avg annotator score','1–5', 'Gold standard ground truth',     'Slow and expensive',     '≥ 4.0/5',  'End-to-End','#64B5F6'),
]

for i, (metric, formula, rng, best_for, limitation, threshold, category, color) in enumerate(table_rows):
    row_y = 6.6 - i * 0.52
    if i % 2 == 0:
        row_bg = FancyBboxPatch((0.5, row_y-0.22), 26.8, 0.44,
                                 boxstyle="square,pad=0", linewidth=0,
                                 edgecolor='none', facecolor='#FFFFFF08')
        ax.add_patch(row_bg)

    ax.text(col_x[0], row_y, metric,     fontsize=8, color=color, fontweight='bold', va='center')
    ax.text(col_x[1], row_y, formula,    fontsize=7.5, color='#FFE082', va='center', style='italic')
    ax.text(col_x[2], row_y, rng,        fontsize=8, color='#80DEEA', va='center')
    ax.text(col_x[3], row_y, best_for,   fontsize=7.5, color='#A5D6A7', va='center')
    ax.text(col_x[4], row_y, limitation, fontsize=7.5, color='#FFAB91', va='center')
    ax.text(col_x[5], row_y, threshold,  fontsize=8, color='#4CAF50', va='center', fontweight='bold')

    cat_colors = {'Retrieval': '#7B1FA2', 'Generation': '#E65100', 'End-to-End': '#1565C0'}
    cat_bg = FancyBboxPatch((col_x[6]-0.2, row_y-0.18), 3.8, 0.36,
                              boxstyle="round,pad=0.05", linewidth=1,
                              edgecolor=cat_colors.get(category, '#666'),
                              facecolor=cat_colors.get(category, '#666') + '44')
    ax.add_patch(cat_bg)
    ax.text(col_x[6]+1.7, row_y, category, fontsize=7.5, color='white',
            fontweight='bold', va='center', ha='center')

plt.savefig('rag_evaluation_complete_reference.png', dpi=150,
            bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='#0D1117')
plt.show()
print("✅ Complete RAG Evaluation Reference Map saved!")
```
